content:
As the starting prices of the iPhone 18 Pro and Pro Max are $100 higher than the previous generation, Apple has extended the price increase to the entire iPhone lineup, including some models that have received no changes at all.

This means the base iPhone 17 has gone from $799 to $899. Similarly, the iPhone Air's starting price has officially broken into four figures, set at $1,099.

Both the iPhone 17e and iPhone 16 have also seen $100 price increases. The iPhone 17e has gone from the previous $599 to $699.

Of course, this situation may give consumers pause — these iPhone models have already been on the market for a year, yet their prices have gone up without any changes whatsoever.

However, Apple has always adjusted to market conditions, such as rising component costs for RAM and storage, and this time the increase is only $100, which is less than what some analysts had originally expected.

Below is the complete iPhone pricing after today's adjustments:

  • iPhone 17e: 256GB, $699
  • iPhone 16: 128GB, $799
  • iPhone 17: 256GB, $899
  • iPhone Air: 256GB, $1,099
  • iPhone 18 Pro: 256GB, $1,199
  • iPhone 18 Pro Max: 256GB, $1,299
  • iPhone Duo: 256GB, $1,999

With the launch of the iPhone 18 Pro, the iPhone 17 Pro has been discontinued. The base iPhone 17 is expected to be replaced by a new iPhone in the spring of 2027.

Apple has split its release cycle, with only the high-end new models launching this fall, while the base and Air updates are expected to arrive between March and April next year.
